name: specsket
description: Research specifiable products, compare category-aware completeness, and stage evidence-backed product or supplier records for review.

interface.shortDescription: Fast product shortlists and deep Specsket workflows
interface.longDescription: Tag Specsket Workflows Beta to analyze client files in ChatGPT, dynamically profile and normalize product families, or run product discovery and supplier onboarding. Enable the separate Specsket MCP Tools Beta connection for live schemas, taxonomy, deterministic validation, staged review records, and signed-in review links. The plugin cannot publish or approve records.
defaultPrompt: Find a fast shortlist of products for my project
Deeply assess these selected products for specification readiness
Normalize these files into Specsket products
Research and stage these supplier proposals
